info.title: Classroom Anonymous Course API
info.description: No authentication. Any caller may read and modify courses created through this API. ownerId is attribution only. Existing non-public courses are outside this API scope. Use PATCH for partial updates. Active/historical deletions cancel/archive and retain records.
